llm_response.reason: The website mimics legitimate Pokémon Center branding and design, but uses the unofficial and suspicious domain pokemoncenter.co.it, registered very recently in 2025 with hidden ownership. Official Pokémon Center stores do not operate on .co.it domains; their legitimate operations use .com, .jp, and authorized EU domains. The WHOIS information is concealed, which is typical of scam sites, and there is a lack of verifiable company information. This aligns with scam characteristics 4, 7, 16 (non-existent company info, ambiguous privacy, spoofing legitimate brands) and strongly indicates a fake store set up to defraud consumers.
